clue.text: Heavy fuels in great volume

indicators.note: in places the fuels inside the great volume, one piece wrapped round the other

parts.note: a tome is a large heavy book
oils are fuels

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a weighty book is full of heavy fuel oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavy' looks like an adjective for the fuels, but it defines the answer in the sense of laborious.
explanation.definitionFit: Toilsome work is laborious, and heavy work is the same kind of hard going.

clue.text: Wound on the head

parts.note: reads as an injury to the skull, but means cloth wrapped round the head

explanation.definitionFit: A Sikh or Muslim headdress is a long cloth wrapped around the head.

clue.text: Put in this month without hesitation

indicators.note: without here means outside, so this month goes round the hesitation

parts.note: inst., instant, means this month in old business letters
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: An instruction to enter something this month without delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside; INST, short for instant, meant this month in old business letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To insert something is to place it inside something else.

clue.text: Sneakily move the team accepting money

indicators.note: accepting says the team takes the money inside it

parts.note: a side is a team
L stands for pound, money

explanation.surface: A team quietly takes a bribe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' puts L inside SIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: To sidle is to edge along furtively or crabwise.

clue.text: They cut things fine

parts.note: sounds like people who leave little margin, but means machines chopping meat small

explanation.definitionFit: Machines that grind meat into small pieces are named for that chopping.

clue.text: Timid little fellow caught by a surprise attack

indicators.note: caught by says the little fellow is held inside the following words

parts.note: a raid is a sudden surprise attack
F is the short form of fellow

explanation.surface: A nervous little man is ambushed in a sudden assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught by' puts F between A and RAID.
explanation.definitionFit: Being scared or fearful is what timid describes.

clue.text: Constituents forget his prescience

indicators.note: Constituents says the component letters of forget his are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Voters forget a politician's gift for seeing ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constituents' (the letters as parts) rearranges FORGETHIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Prescience is knowledge of events before they happen, seeing ahead.

clue.text: Reacting in rash fashion?

parts.note: seems to mean acting hastily, but means the body producing a skin rash

explanation.definitionFit: Someone sensitive to a substance may break out in spots on contact.

clue.text: Manoeuvres of rider and groom over time

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the groom on top of the time

parts.note: to dress is to groom, as with hair or a horse
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A horse rider and stable lad work together over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is the training of a horse in precise movements by its rider.

clue.text: Dwelling is rented out

indicators.note: out says the letters of is rented are put out of their order

explanation.surface: A notice says a dwelling has been let out to a tenant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges ISRENTED.
explanation.definitionFit: A resident creature is one living or abiding somewhere, the adjectival sense of dwelling.

clue.text: King George I left the French a protective screen

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
taken as written
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A historical note: George I left the French a defensive barrier.
explanation.walkthrough: GR, Georgius Rex, appears on British post boxes of George's reigns.
explanation.definitionFit: A grating or lattice set over an opening serves as a guard or shield.

clue.text: Mount before backing

indicators.note: backing says the word for before is read backwards

parts.note: ante is Latin for before

explanation.surface: A rider must climb up before reversing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns ANTE round.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is a Sicilian volcano, a mountain.

clue.text: Deal allows deputy to hold about half of them

indicators.note: to hold says the deputy keeps the other pieces inside it

parts.note: an agent acts as a deputy for someone
re means about or concerning

indicators.note: half of takes the second two of the four letters of them

explanation.surface: A bargain lets a deputy keep about half of the takings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half of' takes EM, the back half of 'them'; 'allows' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A deal is a settled arrangement or pact between parties.

clue.text: Drunks receiving the right orders

indicators.note: receiving says the drunks take the right inside them

parts.note: sots are habitual drunkards

explanation.surface: Drunken men are being given their proper instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receiving' puts R inside SOTS; 'orders' is a verb, as in arranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To sort things is to arrange them, putting them in order.

clue.text: Some nincompoop usually does this work

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A fool will usually produce a piece of work like this one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks the letters spanning nincompOOP USually.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical or literary composition is called a work, the Latin word for which is used of it.

clue.text: Dispute is on the level and he'll seek legal re, dress

parts.note: plain means level or flat
a tiff is a minor quarrel

explanation.surface: A row is honest, and the man goes to court for compensation.
explanation.walkthrough: The dispute comes after the level piece; 'is' and 'and' are link words. The printed 're, dress' is redress, legal compensation.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaintiff is the party who brings a civil action in court.

clue.text: There's often a catch in it

definitions.text: There's often a catch in it

parts.words: There's often a catch in it
parts.note: reads like a warning about a hidden drawback, but means a pastime that yields fish on a line

explanation.definitionFit: The sport of fishing with rod and line aims to land a catch.

clue.text: Poles involved in rescue making reproaches

indicators.note: involved says the letters are mixed together

parts.note: N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Polish people caught up in a rescue face criticism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' mixes N and S with RESCUE; 'making' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Censures are formal rebukes, expressions of strong disapproval.

clue.text: Watch a person who does it again

definitions.meaning: a watch that chimes the hours when a button is pressed

definitions.text: a person who does it again

explanation.definitionFit: A chiming timepiece and someone who does things twice share this name.

clue.text: Regard clean up as nonsense

parts.note: to eye something is to regard it
to wash is to clean up

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a suggestion to tidy up as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyewash is a slang term for rubbish or humbug meant to deceive.

clue.text: A writer's confidence

definitions.meaning: Anthony ... wrote The Prisoner of Zenda
trust or expectation that something will happen

explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Hope was a novelist, and expectation of good things is optimism.

clue.text: Name the appointment hour

parts.note: a set time is the appointed one

explanation.surface: A secretary is asked to give the time fixed for a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Seth is a man's given name, borne by the third son of Adam.

clue.text: There's evidence of a leak-read the paper!

parts.note: to see is to read or take in
a page is a sheet of paper

explanation.surface: A newspaper headline exposing a leak of information.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid oozing slowly through shows that something is escaping.

clue.text: A quarter possibly tried to walk

parts.note: S, south, is one of the four quarters of the compass

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of tried could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Someone from a certain district tried going on foot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges TRIED to TRIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: To stride is to walk with long steps.

clue.text: Five hundred will be in a hole before Christmas

indicators.note: will be in says the Roman number goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: a vent is a hole or opening
D is the Roman numeral 500

explanation.surface: A large sum of money will be in the red before Christmas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will be in' puts D between A and VENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Advent is the church season leading up to December 25th.

clue.text: Hard-back

explanation.definitionFit: A strict person is severe, and a vessel's rear is its aft end.

clue.text: Quietly considered an affront offered

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical mark for quietly
to resent something is to take it as an insult

explanation.surface: A gift was received in silence and taken as an insult.
explanation.definitionFit: Something presented has been handed over or given formally.

clue.text: Cheer up retiring relation with a note

indicators.note: retiring, drawing back, says the word for relation runs backwards

parts.note: a relation is an account or tale
E is a note of the musical scale

explanation.surface: Cheering up a withdrawn relative with a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' turns TALE into ELAT; 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To elate someone is to make them happy and lift their spirits.

clue.text: Keep it and earn breaks

indicators.note: breaks says the letters of it and earn are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to hold on to money and earn some time off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' rearranges ITEARN.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold on to something is to keep it in your possession.

clue.text: Periodical repository for ammunition

definitions.meaning: a periodical is a journal issued at regular intervals
a store for arms or the chamber holding cartridges in a gun

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a regularly issued publication and a store or chamber for weapons supplies.

clue.text: First to be affected by Eastern conflict

indicators.note: to be affected says the letters of First are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: The first to suffer in an eastern war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be affected' rearranges FIRST to STRIF; 'by' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Strife is bitter disagreement or fighting.

clue.text: Housing adult males in principle

indicators.note: in says the adult males are placed inside the principle

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or belief
men are adult males

explanation.surface: A principle of providing homes for grown men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Housing' looks like a verb for the container, but it is the definition, a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A block of flats or rented dwellings provides homes for people.
